answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a 250-token bond locked for 12 days and clear two randomly assigned peer audits before its voting weight turns on. Each further account from the same operator lifts the bond by 40% and adds an audit round, so farming cost outgrows farming yield. Auditors recheck signed work receipts on the ledger and slash the bond on any mismatch. Every approved identity gets a sable seal, its whole record acts as a mirror the network can inspect, and a delta score tracks how far its claims drift from verified work.
